newsitem.title: USA: Chase starts mortgage reinsurance unit.
newsitem.headline: Chase starts mortgage reinsurance unit.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp said it has received approval from the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) to launch a subsidiary that will underwrite mortgage guaranty reinsurance.
The subsidiary, Cross Country Insurance Co, will reinsure a portion of the mortgage insurance on loans originated or purchased by the bank or its lending affiliates, Chase said.

The company said it believes Chase USA is the first U.S. bank granted such powers. Chase said the subsidiary will begin operations immediately. A spokesman said Cross Country will be a monoline company with mortgage reinsurance its only business.

Thomas Jacob, executive vice president of Chase, said Amerin Guaranty Corp, one of Chase's primary mortgage insurers, worked with Chase to develop the reinsurance program. A spokesman said Cross Country in the initial phase will work exclusively with Amerin Guaranty but over time it will work with others as well. Amerin Guaranty is a unit of Amerin Corp.
